profile_text.body:
Ericsson is a public company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden, traded under the ticker ERIC and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000717826. On its own site the company describes itself as powering the networks that connect billions, working across 5G, AI and cloud to serve communications providers and enterprises. It says it offers secure, reliable enterprise connectivity that unites those three areas, and connectivity solutions aimed at productivity, scalability and resilience.

Much of the site's material is framed around where networks are heading. Ericsson says its CTO writes about four shifts shaping the network into what the company calls a programmable, autonomous and AI-native intelligent fabric. It presents perspectives on 6G as a fabric connecting people and machines through mobile, cloud and AI systems, on building trusted AI for networks, and on advanced 5G capabilities including network slicing, orchestration and AI-driven tools. It also describes an Open Radio Access Network transformation at AT&T, which it says has laid the foundation for an open, disaggregated and programmable network.

The record held here lists no products, no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company, so the profile rests on the company's own descriptions of its network and AI work.
